_comment: Models the Private Assistant offers: the newest open models, checked live on ollama.com/library on 2026-11-04. download_bytes = sum of the layers in the Ollama library manifest (registry.ollama.ai); the page uses it until Ollama reports the real total. ram_need_gib = memory the model takes while it answers (measured: Ollama's model runner at an 8k context, KV cache included; the 26B is an estimate). auto = the setup page may suggest it (the biggest auto model that fits the memory budget); the others are offered on request only. Nothing is downloaded until the owner presses the button. Every model gets think:false (all of them think by default in Ollama, which is very slow on a processor). sizing: budget = min(free memory now, lowest free memory in the last 7 days) - margin_gib - webui_gib - cache_gib; below min_free_gib of free memory nothing is suggested; a paused model is used again once free memory is resume_extra_gib above the line.

models.name: LFM3 1.7B
models.label: Very small
models.about: Tiny and very quick, for short questions. It makes more mistakes and is weaker in Slovenian.

models.name: Qwen3.5 4B
models.label: Small
models.about: Small and quick. Good for everyday questions, short summaries and writing help, also in Slovenian.

models.name: Gemma 4 E4B
models.label: Small, quick follow-ups
models.about: Google's small model. About as smart as Qwen3.5 4B and needs more memory, but answers follow-up questions sooner.

models.name: Qwen3.5 9B
models.label: Medium
models.about: Clearly smarter than the small models and still fine for chatting. The best at explaining your box.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B
models.label: Large
models.about: The smartest model that fits next to an Ethereum node, and still quick. Needs about 20 GB of free memory.
